title: Fluids in Motion, Siphons & Pumps
intro: Flow, Bernoulli, valves and the pumps that move Kenya's water — from the Afridev hand pump to the sump pump and the ram pump.

lessons.title: Measuring Flow: Litres per Second
lessons.focus: Time a jerrican filling at the tap; flow rate = volume/time; compare taps, trickles and the river (float method teaser).
lessons.advanced: A 20 L jerrican fills in 45 s: flow rate in L/s and L/hour; how long to fill a 1000 L tank?

lessons.title: Narrow Pipe, Faster Flow: Continuity
lessons.focus: Thumb over the hose speeds the jet; rivers quicken at narrows; A₁v₁ = A₂v₂ for incompressible flow.
lessons.advanced: Pipe narrows from 5 cm to 2 cm diameter: compute the speed-up factor from areas.

lessons.title: The Bernoulli Surprise I: Papers That Kiss
lessons.focus: Blow between two hanging papers — they come together; fast air = lower pressure; ball levitating in a jet.
lessons.advanced: Use Bernoulli's equation qualitatively to rank pressures at three points in a narrowing pipe.

lessons.title: The Bernoulli Surprise II: Roofs, Sprays and Dust Devils
lessons.focus: Why mabati roofs lift in storms; perfume/pesticide atomizers; wind over a chimney draws smoke; safe-roof discussion.
lessons.advanced: Estimate uplift force: wind 20 m/s over a 40 m² roof using ΔP≈½ρv² (ρ=1.2).

lessons.title: Curve Balls: The Magnus Effect
lessons.focus: Football free kicks bend; throw a bottle with spin and watch it drift; spin drags air and makes a pressure difference.
lessons.advanced: Explain top-spin vs back-spin effects on flight using pressure differences.

lessons.title: Pumps: Moving Water Against Gravity
lessons.focus: Survey: hand pumps, diesel pumps, electric pumps, solar pumps across Kenya; what all pumps share (a moving seal).
lessons.advanced: Rank hand, diesel and solar pumps for a 20-family village by lifetime cost and reliability; defend with assumptions.

lessons.title: Lift Pumps: The Afridev and the 10-Metre Limit
lessons.focus: Hand pump anatomy: piston, valves, the atmosphere does the lifting; why suction fails beyond ~10 m.
lessons.advanced: Derive the max suction lift from P=ρgh with atmospheric pressure; why is practical lift only ~7 m?

lessons.title: Force Pumps: Pushing Water Upward
lessons.focus: Force pump pushes water above the pump itself; bicycle pump as air force-pump; pressure washer idea.
lessons.advanced: Compare lift vs force pump for raising water 25 m from a deep well: which and why?

lessons.title: Centrifugal Pumps: Spinning Water Outward
lessons.focus: Bucket on a string swung = water thrown outward; impeller idea; most electric borehole pumps are centrifugal.
lessons.advanced: Explain why a centrifugal pump must be primed but a positive-displacement pump self-primes.

lessons.title: The Sump Pump: Draining the Pit
lessons.focus: Flooded basements and pit latrines in Nairobi rains; float switch rises with water; check valve stops backflow; submersible vs pedestal.
lessons.advanced: Design the float-switch geometry: at what water level should the pump cut in and out, and why a gap between them?

lessons.title: Project: The Siphon Garden System I — Design
lessons.focus: Overhead tank → tube over the bund → furrows below; plan heights, tube routing, distribution points for a school garden.
lessons.advanced: Compute available head and predict flow for a 15 mm tube using Torricelli reasoning.

lessons.title: Project: The Siphon Garden System II — Build and Test
lessons.focus: Install tubes, start siphons safely, measure flow at each outlet; map flow vs head difference.
lessons.advanced: Plot flow vs head; why does real flow fall below the √2gh ideal? (Friction in the tube.)

lessons.title: Project: The Siphon Garden System III — Troubleshoot and Maintain
lessons.focus: Air leaks, blockages, algae; priming ritual; seasonal checklist; handover document for next year's class.
lessons.advanced: Write the fault tree: no flow → (air in crest? inlet uncovered? outlet above inlet?) with a test for each branch.

lessons.title: Valves: The Heart of Every Pump
lessons.focus: One-way flap valves from inner-tube rubber; watch one work on a clear tube; heart valves analogy; check valves in pumps.
lessons.advanced: Explain the pumping cycle as two valves opening alternately; what failure does a leaking inlet valve cause?

lessons.title: Build: A Hand Diaphragm Pump I
lessons.focus: Bottle + rubber diaphragm + two flap valves = working lift pump; assemble the pump head.
lessons.advanced: Estimate litres per stroke from diaphragm displacement; predict strokes per jerrican.

lessons.title: Build: A Hand Diaphragm Pump II — Performance Test
lessons.focus: Measure L/min at lift heights 0.5/1.0/1.5 m; graph performance; compare against a commercial pump spec.
lessons.advanced: Fit flow vs height trend; compute the pump's useful power at 1 m lift (P=ρgQh).

lessons.title: The Hydraulic Ram: Water That Pumps Itself
lessons.focus: Water hammer: stop a flowing column suddenly and pressure spikes; ram pumps lift a fraction high using only falling water; Kenyan hillside sites.
lessons.advanced: Explain the ram cycle (waste valve, delivery valve, air chamber) as momentum becoming pressure.

lessons.title: Teacher-Led Build: A Mini Ram Pump I
lessons.focus: Bottle air-chamber + two flap valves + drive pipe; teacher-led assembly of a demonstration ram.
lessons.advanced: Compute the drive head and delivery head of your rig; estimate the efficiency fraction Q·H/(q·h).

lessons.title: Teacher-Led Build: A Mini Ram Pump II — Tuning
lessons.focus: Tune waste-valve weight and air chamber; measure delivery per minute; discuss real installations (AidFoundation/ram pump groups).
lessons.advanced: Why does the air chamber smooth the delivery flow? Quantify with your pulsation count before/after.

lessons.title: Irrigation Physics: Drip, Furrow and Sprinkler
lessons.focus: Drip needs little pressure, sprinkler lots; gravity drip kits from a raised jerrican; water budgeting for dry seasons.
lessons.advanced: A bed needs 5 mm of water on 4 m² daily: compute litres/day and the drip-line hours at your measured rate.

lessons.title: Rivers, Bridges and Floods: Motion at Large Scale
lessons.focus: Fast water undermines bridge piers (scour); flood energy; gabions and check dams slow water; Kenyan flood examples.
lessons.advanced: Explain with KE∝v² why doubling flood speed quadruples its destructive energy per unit mass.

lessons.title: Unit Review: Water Works Expo
lessons.focus: All pumps and the siphon garden running; student engineers explain; unit quiz.
lessons.advanced: Write the expo quiz's hard question: a two-valve pump fault diagnosis with full reasoning.
